cohort: A 30-year-old woman, para 1 living 1, with a previous cesarean delivery nine years prior.
finding: Laparoscopic excision and repair is an effective surgical technique for huge isthmoceles, which can develop endometriomas in their wall over time as a consequence of previous cesarean delivery, relieving symptoms like pain and bleeding.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery, particularly with poor uterine incision healing, can lead to the development of isthmoceles and associated endometriomas, causing symptoms such as chronic pelvic pain and infertility.
